headline: Kolkata's sewage-treatment promises
intro: Dated commitments from KMC's own statutory filings. Two KEIIP plants were recorded at 17% and 14% completion against a March 2022 deadline in a document filed December 2021; what happened next is not in the public record we have found, so their status reads 'unknown' rather than a guess.

commitments.title: Commission the 45 MLD STP at Near WBSETCL, Joka
commitments.what: KMC's District Environment Plan 2021 records this plant at 17% completion with a stated timeline of March, 2022 - a deadline already less than four months away when the plan was filed on 1 December 2021.

commitment_source.label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata, p.29

commitments.title: Commission the 40 MLD STP at At Bank Plot, M.G Road
commitments.what: KMC's District Environment Plan 2021 records this plant at 14% completion with a stated timeline of March, 2022 - a deadline already less than four months away when the plan was filed on 1 December 2021.

commitment_source.label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata, p.29
